steps.en: Officer picks a standard email template or edits the email text
steps.id: Officer memilih template email standar atau mengubah isi email

steps.en: Officer chooses the Reject decision on the furnish request
steps.id: Officer memilih keputusan Reject untuk request furnish

steps.en: Officer approves sending the email and adds it to the send list
steps.id: Officer menyetujui pengiriman email dan memasukkannya ke daftar kirim
steps.why_en: Approval exists but is a plain send checkbox, not an approval of a scheduled send.
steps.why_id: Persetujuan ada, tetapi hanya checkbox kirim, bukan persetujuan atas pengiriman terjadwal.

steps.en: Officer sets the date and time the email should go out
steps.id: Officer menentukan tanggal dan jam email akan dikirim
steps.why_en: No date or time field exists; emails are sent immediately.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada kolom tanggal atau jam; email langsung dikirim.

steps.en: The update of the furnished hirer or driver particulars is rejected
steps.id: Update particulars hirer atau driver yang di-furnish ditolak
